name: Epitanime
blurb: Student-run anime convention (the Matsuri) hosted by EPITA/Epitech students near Paris.
notes: The most recent Matsuri ran 13 June 2026 at Campus Epita/Epitech, Le Kremlin-Bicêtre; already past as of 2026-10-05. The site's news feed only has recap posts dated through 20 June 2026 with no mention of a 2027 date yet, so editions is empty.
